items.summary: Global charts. One database. Folded paper charts, thick binders and the endless search for the right page used to be part of every flight. With Talora Navigation Charts, they're history. Talora brings navigation charts into one connected EFB platform: - 32,000+ airports worldwide in one chart database - Your route, waypoints and own-ship position on one map - Weather overlay along the route, switched on with a single tap - Navigation, weather and terrain layers combined as you need them - Always current and available offline All-in-One. Connected. Configurable. #EFB #NavigationCharts #Electron
